## Topical Authority Content Clusters (8 Comprehensive Guides)

### Cluster 01: Semantic SEO & Knowledge Graph Engineering
- [Semantic SEO & Knowledge Graph Triples: How Google Understands Entities](https://yoonverse.in/blog/semantic-seo-triples-knowledge-graph): Engineering Subjectâ€“Predicateâ€“Object (SPO) triples, Entityâ€“Attributeâ€“Value (EAV) HTML `<dl>` tables, and connected `@graph` JSON-LD with Wikidata `sameAs` reconciliation.
- [How Google Search Actually Works (In Plain English)](https://yoonverse.in/blog/how-google-search-works): The 4-stage pipeline of modern search: Crawling, Rendering, Entity Indexing, and Intent-Based Ranking.

### Cluster 02: Visual Semantic SEO & Multimodal Search
- [Visual Semantic SEO: Optimizing Above-the-Fold Images for Google Vision AI](https://yoonverse.in/blog/visual-semantic-seo-guide): How Google Cloud Vision AI extracts OCR text and entity labels from hero images, and how to pair `fetchpriority="high"` `<figure>` elements with `ImageObject` (`representativeOfPage: true`).

### Cluster 03: Topical Authority & Content Architecture
- [Topical Authority & Content Clusters: How to Rank Without Keyword Stuffing](https://yoonverse.in/blog/topical-authority-content-clusters): Designing hub-and-spoke content networks, mapping distinct search intents per URL, and building semantic anchor text graphs.
- [Keyword Research for Beginners: Find What People Actually Search](https://yoonverse.in/blog/keyword-research-for-beginners): Decoding informational, commercial, and transactional search intent before writing a single word.

### Cluster 04: Technical SEO & Search Analytics
- [The SEO Analyst Playbook: Auditing Queries, CTR & Entity Signals in Search Console](https://yoonverse.in/blog/seo-analyst-search-console-audit-framework): Finding Position 4â€“15 striking-distance queries, diagnosing CTR gaps, eliminating URL cannibalization, and auditing indexing states.
- [A Calm, 10-Point Technical SEO Checklist for Any Website](https://yoonverse.in/blog/technical-seo-checklist): Auditing indexability, canonical tags, XML sitemaps, internal link depth, Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), and structured data.
- [How to Track AI Traffic in GA4 (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Copilot)](https://yoonverse.in/blog/how-to-track-ai-traffic-in-ga4): Building custom GA4 Explorations and regex channel filters to measure referrals from generative AI answer engines.
